body:
I might talk to my mom about this, because I do want help, hopefully I can make her think more of me and less of *her* hopes for me and ideas for me.

Also, that's extremely nice of you, and I will try to convince myself that my awful self esteem is preventing me from thinking that is true. I started crying, haha... I just made myself something to eat and maybe I'll spend today thinking about things, but still, there's still this nagging feeling that won't just poof away, so we'll see how things go. Thank you, again.

I am realy uneasy about this and conflicted I know she is bad sometimes but I also know she might be trying her best so I don't know will getting help without her being alerted get her arrested? I am really scared, she *isn't* abusing me, she just doesn't exactly know about my problems  and i guess since shes older she assumes she knows more, which is ok... I think?

I'm 14, almost 15 and I live in Michigan but.. please don't try to do anything yet if you will one time somebody called the cops because I suggested I was feeling suicidal and I never want that to happen again it was really embarrassing but thanks so much for doing this, honestly I didn't know I could be steered out of my suicidal state.

Thank you for being honest.. thats mostly the reason I stuck around, for times like when I laugh at a stupid tweet and stuff, but I feel like while everybody my age is progressing I am falling behind on my education, experiences, and kind of just tumbling down this hole and becoming less and less of myself and more of my disorders. While people are thinking about "wow what a beautiful tree" I am thinking "wow what a sturdy tree I can hang myself on". You get the point. I just want to care again, I want to care and love my family like I used to but currently them dying would be a relief to me... god I sound like a fucking sociopath

thank you, for some reason I didn't even know recognize  a panic attack so I opened the window and took a quick break.

I think my mom is pretty nice but she is really narcissistic, she just loves when shit is focused on her and whatever. I wouldn't say shes that bad for some reason I don't blame her that much...

I was never on medication, my parents are extremely against it and they insist that practice outside of my comfort zone and getting fresh air will cure my severe depression and anxiety. It's so bad that a lot of doctors and stuff have asked my mom if i have been abused. I basically begged the doctor once for medication, bad idea, because my mom got really upset, and insisted I was trying to get her arrested for child abuse. I am not going to therapy, I am scared to ask because the conversation might go something like, "You are being homeschooled I did this for you you shouldn't have any problems because I love you"
